plan.failureSummary: The cached page.ai instruction replayed a stale selector (`div:nth-of-type(2) > button`) that clicked the "Solutions" dropdown instead of "Developers". As a result, navigation to `/docs/` did not occur, causing the URL assertion to fail. Clearing the page.ai cache will allow page.ai to discover the updated "Developers" nav element.
observedIndicators: Cached page.ai instruction replayed selector `div:nth-of-type(2) > button` which targeted the "Solutions" nav item instead of "Developers".
Browser remained at `https://www.checklyhq.com/` instead of navigating to `https://www.checklyhq.com/docs/`.
Assertion `expect(page.url()).toEqual('https://www.checklyhq.com/docs/')` failed with expected `/docs/` but received root URL.
Failure screenshot confirms the 'Developers' navigation menu is active and visible on the page.

remediationSteps.summary: Clear stale page.ai cache and retry test run
remediationSteps.details: Clear stale page.ai deterministic cache and rerun the automated test flow. page.ai will locate the 'Developers' menu on the current layout and navigate to '/docs/'.

plan.notes: Live screenshot shows 'Developers' option is present in the top nav bar (3rd position), but cached selector targeted 2nd position ('Solutions'). Clearing cache will resolve the issue.
